card.title: 3rd MORSKOI PEKHOTY
card.text: Deployment: Add a LIGHT INFANTRY to your support line and a BLAST to your hand.
card.flavorText: The 3rd Naval Infantry Brigade of the Baltic Fleet was formed in July 1941, when the Soviet Union turned sailors and naval base personnel into infantry to meet the German and Finnish advance. Its first men came from forces based at Kronstadt, Peterhof, and Oranienbaum. The brigade entered combat almost at once in Karelia near the Vidlitsa River. These sailors fought far from ships, often in forests, river lines, and fortified positions along Lake Ladoga and the Svir. In September 1941, the brigade was pressed back toward Lake Ladoga and had to be evacuated by the Ladoga Military Flotilla. It later held a bridgehead on the north bank of the Svir for a long period. In 1944, during the Svir Petrozavodsk Offensive, the brigade landed behind Finnish lines as part of the Tuloksa landing. It later received the Order of the Red Banner and the honorific title “Pechenga”, then fought in northern Norway and Czechoslovakia before the war ended.
